title: Canine Wedding Services
excerpt: Want your dog at your wedding? We'll look after them on the day, whether they have a starring role in the ceremony or simply join the photos.
intro: For many couples, the big day isn't complete without the dog. We'll bring our professional, experienced help to make sure your day runs smoothly. Whether your dog plays a key part in the ceremony or joins you at the venue for the photos, we'll take care of them so you don't have to.
highlights: Dog chaperone for the ceremony, photos or the whole day
Collection from home and safe transport to your venue
Experienced handlers who keep your dog calm, comfortable and camera-ready
Planned around your timings and venue
pricingNote: Give us a call to talk through your plans. We look forward to helping make your day the best it can be.
